assertions.name: T1_rdmr_off_curve
assertions.source: at theta_mu = 0 the curve forces theta_p = 0.23550853, not 0 — A-free refutation of the Rademacher route

description: Bean qou-qnnq: derives the A_omega-free constraint curve that any independent theta-route must satisfy. Eliminating A_omega between the two anchor equations of S_K = A_omega*kappa*(ln^2 q0 - theta^2) leaves (L - theta_mu^2)/(L - theta_p^2) = S_mu/S_p, an invariant built from measured S values alone (no A_omega, no q0). This is the falsifiable content the T4 chain carries despite being underdetermined by one. A route landing on the curve determines A_omega rather than importing it. First application: the qou-rdmr Rademacher prediction theta_mu = theta_p = 0 is OFF the curve, refuting it WITHOUT assuming A_omega = 3. Fixes no value of A_omega; wires nothing.

data.constraint_curve: theta_p^2 = L - (L - theta_mu^2)/r,  L = ln^2 q0
data.q0_note: the T4 probe hardcodes q0 = 1.11020 while the canonical substrate value is ~1.10998; r is q0-free but the curve is not, so both grids are reported
data.verdict: THE T4 CHAIN DOES CARRY ONE FALSIFIABLE, A-FREE STATEMENT. Eliminating A_ω between the two anchor equations leaves (ln²q₀ − ϑ_μ²)/(ln²q₀ − ϑ_p²) = S_μ/S_p = -0.2453912076, an invariant built from measured S values alone — no A_ω, no q₀. Any route supplying BOTH ϑ values is testable against this curve with no conditioning inherited, and a route that lands on it DETERMINES A_ω = S_μ/(κ(ln²q₀ − ϑ_μ²)) — which would be the arc's first genuine determination rather than a literature import. Control C0 passes (the T4 pair lies on the curve, as it must by construction). First application, T1: qou-rdmr's Rademacher prediction ϑ_μ = ϑ_p = 0 is OFF the curve — at ϑ_μ = 0 the curve forces ϑ_p = 0.23550853, so the Rademacher symbol is refuted WITHOUT assuming A_ω = 3, upgrading that scope-(a) result from a comparison against conditioned targets to an A-free one. SCOPE: this fixes no value of A_ω and wires nothing; it states in falsifiable form what an independent route (qou-offl, or any successor to qou-rdmr) must reproduce. The measured S values are taken as given.
